errors.pollFailed: An error occured during download. Please check your connection and try again. If the problem persists, please contact the Erudi team.
errors.stalled: The download finished but the app is taking longer than expected to finalize it. The files have been saved. Restart Erudi and check your installed models before downloading again.

codes.offline: The download stopped because there is no internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
codes.diskFull: The disk is full. Free some space, then start the download again.
codes.gated: This model needs a Hugging Face account to download, which Erudi does not use. Choose another model.
codes.notFound: This model was not found on Hugging Face. It may have been removed, renamed or made private.
codes.rateLimited: Hugging Face is receiving too many requests right now. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
codes.interrupted: The download was interrupted because Erudi closed. Start it again.
codes.noEngineArtifact: This repository has no files this computer can run. Choose a version of the model made for it, for example one found through the Hugging Face search.
codes.rawGgufChunks: This model is published in pieces that must be joined before it can run, which Erudi does not do. Choose another repository of this model.
codes.incompleteSplit: A part of this model is missing on Hugging Face, so it could not run. Choose another version of the model.
codes.unsafeFileName: This repository contains a file name Erudi refuses to write, for safety. Choose another repository.
codes.notRunnable: This model is known not to run on this computer. Choose another model.
codes.integrityFailed: The downloaded files are incomplete or invalid, so they were removed. Start the download again.

hardwareWait.title: ⏳ Please Wait
hardwareWait.body: We're still checking your system capabilities. This will only take a moment.

delete.title: Delete Model
delete.confirmQuestion: Are you sure you want to delete the model <name>{{name}}</name>?
delete.dependentsNote: Assistants will remain and must be re-bound to another model; conversations are kept.

embeddingGate.promptBody: The Knowledge Base needs an embedding model to index and search your documents. Download the recommended model (multilingual-e5-small)? It is fetched once and stored locally.
embeddingGate.downloadingBody: Downloading the embedding model… This can take a minute. You can leave this page — the download keeps running.
embeddingGate.doneBody: The embedding model was downloaded successfully. The Knowledge Base is ready to use.
embeddingGate.errorBody: The embedding model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
embeddingGate.bannerMissing: This assistant's Knowledge Base needs its embedding model, which is not downloaded. Document search is off until it is.
embeddingGate.bannerDownloading: Downloading the embedding model… Document search will work once it is done.
embeddingGate.bannerError: The embedding model could not be downloaded.

waitingForInstall: Waiting for the download to finish installing…
